Company Overview

Professional leather manufacturing for global B2B buyers

PrimeCraft Partners is a Sialkot-based OEM leather manufacturer specializing in leather vests, leather jackets, leather gloves, leather pants and custom leather apparel for brands, distributors, wholesalers, retailers and importers worldwide.

OEM ServicesRequest Quote

Mission

Help brands manufacture dependable leather products with clean execution, flexible MOQ and export-ready finishing.

Experience

Production knowledge across vests, jackets, gloves, pants, labels, trims and specialty leather finishes.

Quality Control

Material review, stitching checks, measurement control and packing checks before dispatch.

Export Capability

Serving buyers in the United States, Canada, Europe, United Kingdom and Australia.
